name: Mexican Hot Chocolate Cookie Balls with Cinnamon & Cayenne Pepper

instructions.primary_message: Medium dice cream cheese and place in a medium bowl. Set aside to soften.
Meanwhile, line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper and set aside.
Place cookies in a resealable bag and crush with a rolling pin (or heavy saucepan) until they are broken into a fine crumb. (Alternatively, you can use a food processor.)
Add cookie crumbs to the bowl with the softened cream cheese along with cinnamon and cayenne. Using a spoon (or your hands), mix until the dough comes together and is evenly combined. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
½ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil.

Uncover the pan and place a medium, heat-proof, bowl over the simmering water, allowing it to sit on the rim. Add chocolate to the bowl; using a silicone spatula, stir continuously, until melted. Remove bowl from the heat.
While the chocolate is melting, use a heaping tablespoon measure to scoop out and portion the dough. Use your hands to roll the dough into balls and place on the prepared baking sheet.
Using a fork, dip the cookie balls, one at a time, in the chocolate. Turn to coat and return to the baking sheet. Top with desired amount of marshmallows, pressing gently to adhere.
Place baking sheet in the refrigerator and chill until chocolate is firm, 15-20 minutes.
To serve, arrange cookie balls on a platter. Enjoy!
